test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian dancers was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2020 for contribution to Odissi dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabindra Atibudhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindra Atibudhi:-**

 
 
• He was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2020 for contribution to Odissi dance.
 
• He is an Indian dancer who specializes in the Odissi dance form.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:-**
 
 
• It is a prestigious national-level award given to artists who have made a significant contribution to their respective fields. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brajendra Kumar Pattnaik:-**

 
 
• He is also a well-known Odissi dancer who has received several awards for his contributions to the art form.
 
 
 
• **Balkar Sidhu:-**
 
 
• He is a Punjabi singer.
 
 
 
• Pasumarthy Vithal:-
 
 
• He is a Telugu actor, neither of whom are known for their contributions to Odissi dance.
